problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: To tackle this issue, we replace the cross-modal interaction module with a cross-modal common space, in which moment-query alignment is learned and efficient moment search can be performed.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: For the sake of robustness in the learned space, we propose a fine-grained semantic distillation framework to transfer knowledge from additional semantic structures.

problems.name: Scalability and Corpus-Level Retrieval
problems.evidence_sentence: For example, to localize moments in a video corpus [46, 30], it usually requires us to perform efﬁcient VMR on hundreds to thousands of candidate videos for a given natural language query.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: To tackle this issue, we replace the cross-modal interaction module with a cross-modal common space, in which moment-query alignment is learned and efficient moment search can be performed.

methods.name: Weak-Supervision and Pseudo-Label Correction
methods.evidence_sentence: For the sake of robustness in the learned space, we propose a fine-grained semantic distillation framework to transfer knowledge from additional semantic structures.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: In such a space, for the given query, it is nearly cost-free to obtain the matching score of each moment proposal, i.e., we can simply calculate the similarities between video moment features and the query sentence feature in the common space by using efﬁcient vector operations like dot product.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: A hierarchical semantic-guided attention module is designed to perform message propagation across the whole tree and yield discriminative features.
